meta.description: Public volunteer opportunity registry (FRD Epic E, §8.3). Recruitment-led, public-safe fields only. Edit here to add, pause or close opportunities, then redeploy, no code change.

generalInterest.title: I'm open to anything
generalInterest.summary: Not sure where you'd fit? Tell us a little about yourself and we'll suggest a way to help that suits you.

opportunities.title: Cub Team Member
opportunities.summary: Help our Cubs enjoy games, activities, badges and adventures. No experience needed, you'll get full training, support and a warm welcome.

opportunities.title: Beaver Helper
opportunities.estimatedCommitment: As often as you can, even now and then helps
opportunities.summary: Lend a hand at Beavers with games, crafts and activities. Come every week or just when you're free, every bit makes a difference.

opportunities.title: Scout Adventure Volunteer
opportunities.summary: Support Scouts with expeditions, camps, cooking and challenges. Great if you enjoy the outdoors and helping young people build independence.

opportunities.title: Camp and Residential Helper
opportunities.summary: Come along to camps and residentials to help things run smoothly, from activities to catering. No weekly commitment at all.
opportunities.skills: Any, cooking, driving and first aid especially useful

opportunities.title: Trustee (Governance)
opportunities.summary: Help steer the Group behind the scenes. Skills in finance, admin, HR, fundraising or governance are especially welcome, no Scouting experience needed.
opportunities.skills: Finance, admin, HR, fundraising or governance
opportunities.experienceRequired: Relevant life or work experience welcome

opportunities.title: Fundraising and Events Helper
opportunities.summary: Help plan and run fundraising and community events that keep Scouting affordable and adventurous. Great for organisers and people-people.
opportunities.skills: Organising, promoting, or just mucking in

opportunities.title: Skills and Support Volunteer
opportunities.summary: Offer a practical skill without a weekly meeting, maintenance, IT, first aid, transport, photography, admin or something else useful.
